purpose: Portable opt-in cache-write and gzip-decoder comparison

tests.stdlib_parity: 1024 baseline cases matched, including 32 error outcomes
tests.isal_parity: 1024 baseline cases matched, including 32 error outcomes

notes: Before snapshot includes prior uncommitted instrumentation changes.

Initial candidate used unconditional buffered writes: mac buffered runs and linux-full-buffered-stdlib use this snapshot. Final code restores mapped default and exposes the same buffered path explicitly.
Final code used for mac-1m-final-default, Linux subset non-before runs, and linux-full-buffered-isal.
Full runs have no full-workload warmup and one repetition. Subset runs have warmup plus three repetitions. No simultaneous benchmarks on a host; not controlled cold-storage trials.
Prior full baselines were from earlier runs, not an interleaved control; not all whole-load improvement can be attributed to writes.
New gzip timing includes readinto/copy work; old baseline timing was inside the stdlib reader.
Mac full ISA-L trial was not pursued after the substantial subset regression.
All full/subset output fingerprints match within their respective input sizes. Production data/caches untouched.
